scenes.caption: A felucca.
scenes.say: Hina drifts down the Nile on a felucca, a small sailing boat.

scenes.caption: The river.
scenes.say: The Nile flows north towards the sea.

scenes.caption: Dark mud.
scenes.say: Dark mud lies on the banks after the flood.

scenes.caption: Growing.
scenes.say: Seeds grow well in this fertile mud.

scenes.caption: Farmers.
scenes.say: Farmers grow wheat, barley and flax beside the river.

scenes.caption: Desert.
scenes.say: Beyond the green banks lies dry desert.

scenes.caption: Pyramids.
scenes.say: In the distance she sees the pyramids of Giza.

scenes.caption: A gift.
scenes.say: Hina understands. The Nile was a gift to Egypt.
